about: The prep, cook and total time a site writes as a phrase instead of ISO 8601 ('1時間30分'), read whole-string only. hours and minutes: case-insensitive regex fragments, tried in order (longest first). joiners: regex fragments that may stand between the hours and the minutes. hourSymbol and minuteSymbol: how the app writes a time back ('1時間 30分'), for ISO times too.
